scope: Named event/context examples for later evidence-backed event studies; no verified date windows, event labels, causal results or corpus assignments produced here.
whole_event_grouping_protocol: Only a separately declared unseen-event generalization experiment requires every member of an event to share one partition. Main classifier groups remain evidence-based work/version/thread/copy/context groups.
overlap_rule: Record multi-event memberships and overlapping analysis/context windows explicitly. Shared actual text/context creates a tied component or review disposition; event co-mention alone does not.
held_out_event_rule: No held-out-event text is used to derive stoplists, vocabulary/IDF, filter rules, thresholds or chunk parameters. Each event-held-out experiment fits its own artifacts on its own training groups.

official_evidence_required: Official emergency-management or meteorological event chronology
events.window_definition_required: Specify anchor, event extent, pre/post analysis windows, context retrieval windows and any separate publication-versus-recalled-event date handling; do not infer them from the label.

official_evidence_required: Official state emergency-management and meteorological accounts for any selected episode
events.window_definition_required: Determine whether this is one broad season context or several evidence-backed regional episodes; a season label alone is not one verified event onset date.

official_evidence_required: Official Queensland and New South Wales flood inquiry chronologies
Official emergency-management or meteorological episode reports
events.window_definition_required: Separate regional episodes and repeated flood periods where official evidence warrants; record cross-event/context overlaps without silently duplicating observations.

official_evidence_required: Official parliamentary records and dated government policy/election documents distinguishing carbon-tax, emissions-trading and broader carbon-pricing debates
events.window_definition_required: Preserve the user's wording as a provisional context label. Verify the underlying policy terminology and chronology before defining an event or asserting that a carbon-tax debate occurred in a particular window.

requires: Stable official evidence URL/title/publisher and document publication date
Verified event chronology with cited source location
Explicit window rule and geographic scope
Registry version/hash frozen before event-model evaluation
Event/context overlap ledger and independent train-artifact manifest
